reviews.x: I love these lashes and so fast shipping. Thank you! :)

20 pairs for this price is incredible and I will continue to buy these over and over! I actually love having them all in a line in a flat box, instead of single packages. I love how thin and lightweight they are. I am someone that has to trim strip lashes always, so it's not a problem to cut these too. Just be very gentle with removing them from the package or you can damage a lash pretty badly (I have 1 lash that cannot be worn. I'm not mad because they were so inexpensive, and was probably jus

I wasn't sure what to expect when buying these. However after reading the previous reviews I thought to give them a try. After all they are for everyday wear. I recently got into wearing false lashes because I like how they enhances the eyes. I am loving them. Today I wore them for the first time. They are holding up just as good as other expensive brands. I like the band. It's black and visible enough for you to see to put it correctly on your eyelid. Mask it with your liquid eyeliner and you a

I was so upset that I spent $10 on these lashes when I've paid $2 for some that were way better. These are so thin and flimsy it's impossible to put them on. I'm an advanced makeup enthusiast and I like lashes with a thicker band, they stick better and are easier to see and manage. These lashes did not even stick, I used 3 different types of glue. I was also looking for something more dramatic, I have pretty short lashes, and these didn't add that much volume or length. waste of time and money.
Will not curve to your eye, had a very difficult time gluing these on, and I do my lashes every day!! Poor quality

First things first: I’m not really into the gigantic lashes that look like windshield wipers on your face. My husband doesn’t like them either. Nor have I met any man who does (not that I’m saying they aren’t out there, I just haven’t met them. That being said, I like that these are natural looking. I did have to do some trimming because they were way too long, but once trimmed they were perfect. I no longer have to go to war with my lashes. So, whoever invented magnetic lashes should receive th

I’m reviewing the zh1/zh2 lashes. I don’t know about the other size. I do like these they are light and thin and give a dramatic look but also stay natural good for everyday wear. I’ve been alternating between the two everyday since I bought them (1week). I used them with duo clear glue. And I don’t out on mascara with them or use a curler. My lashes curl up naturally and are super short. So I love them I put them on and go. The only problem I have with them is that they are alitle tricky to wor

Took a chance and bought these lashes based off of some of the good reviews that I read and was very disapointed. The band of the lashes is very thin and there is no curve to the band at all which makes applying the lashes difficult. Once applied the lashes look very cheap and give a costume-y over the top look instead of looking fluttery and pretty. I ended up trying 3 pairs and trashed the rest. These lashes are terrible.

Was honestly very impressed with how natural these looked! My first pair i put on were different lengths and it took me awhile to figure out why the one felt funny. Ill just remember to double check them when i use the rest. Love the tweezers too. Takes a bit of a learning curve to use them as someone whose not used false lashes in years. Overall great package for the price!

Love the look of these lashes. Came exactly as pictured, not in little trays. Thin translucent eyelash line, not thick/black/bulky like other lashes. I will say that the corners lift easier on these for some reason. Using the same glue as others before but these lift so I just need to add more glue. Look great and are very light! Will buy again.

I’m pretty picky about falsies. I need them to feel as real as they look and these definitely met my standards. They are soft and the band is nice and thin. Not bulky and stiff like most cheap fake lashes. It will take me awhile to get through all of these lol but once I do I will be sure to purchase more. Great value for the price!!

These are lightweight, a good value, and good for probably 2-3 uses if you take care of them when storing. I bought them to add rhinestones and glitter to them and they were easy to decorate. Like most lashes, they should be trimmed a bit to fit the eye properly and they are long enough to allow trimming without looking odd.

I like the lashes.  I am more of a beginner with the strip lashes, having worn extension for the last couple years.  With the Pandemic I needed something to wear sometimes when I want to be lashy, since my own are still growing back.  These do the trick, now that I have figured out how to apply them.  = )

This product is horrible. Total waste of $. The lashes are on actual thread that you would use to see clothing, and the lashes can be pulled off at each end. The weight is also a problem, with a Cotton thread base, the regularly glues won’t work. Also, not curved for the eye. Went directly into the trash.

Great for the everyday lash wear and for the beginner! I love you get a ton of lashes for cheap. They are full and natural looking. Word of advice make sure you trim the lashes because they are long and were too long for the length of my eyelash band.

I purchased these before and they were great for everyday wear so I decided to order more and these suck a$$. They are very hard to apply and these strips are much longer than the first ones I ordered but supposedly they are the same... I hate them

I wear lashes frequently and prefer them not to be too dramatic. These are great for everyday wear. The band is thin and flexible so they go on easy and they do not feel heavy. I also like that there are 2 styles to switch it up.
This first and second time I ordered this lashes they were nice looking false eyelashes all twenty pair where nice looking. This time 1 pack were uneven not useable. I'm very disappointed with them.

reviews.t: Needs some TLC/You get what you pay for
reviews.x: Ok lashes for the price..some of them had gaps in them or we're just shorter than the others like the lashes broke off in some way. Lengthening mascara will fix it though if the gap isn't too big.
i really love both styles! the best thing about these was that there weren’t any ‘bad’ lashes in either box. in the past, i have bought lashes and had to throw some out because they were wonky.
Very happy with these. They are longer than I needed so I just shipped the ends of the lashes. They were easy to apply and he crisscrossing made them look very natural once on the eye.

reviews.t: Not exactly what I was expecting, but I could ...
reviews.x: Not exactly what I was expecting, but I could have not reviewed the description completely. Decent quality but the crossing of the lashes is not the look I was going for.
Not the greatest but will do in a pinch! Look natural and feel like you have nothing there but you have to really work with them to make them stay and hold in place.
All uneven...way longer than expected. Had to trim/shave them down in length and width.  They feel fine on...just have to do too much them to be half way decent.

claims.text: Many reviewers praise the lashes as lightweight and thin, with a natural look.
Several reviewers find the thin band and lack of curve make application difficult.
Reviewers frequently highlight the good value and large quantity for the price.
Some reviewers report quality issues such as uneven lengths, lifting corners, or lashes pulling off the band.
A few reviewers describe the product as poor quality or a waste of money.
